import re

SEC = re.compile(r'^== (?P<s>.+?) ==\s*$')
DT = re.compile(r'^(?P<name>.+?) \((?P<id>com\.apple\.[^()\s]+)\)\s*$')
RT = re.compile(r'^(?P<name>.+?) \((?P<version>\S+) - (?P<build>\S+)\) - (?P<id>\S+)(?: \((?P<status>.*)\))?\s*$')
RH = re.compile(r'^-- (?P<rt>.+?) --\s*$')
DV = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<name>.+?) \((?P<udid>[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36})\) \((?P<state>[^()]+)\)(?: \((?P<avail>.*)\))?\s*$')
PH = re.compile(r'^(?P<pair>[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}) \((?P<status>[^()]*)\)\s*$')
PM = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<role>\w+): (?P<name>.+?) \((?P<udid>[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36})\) \((?P<state>[^()]+)\)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    blocks = {}
    order = []
    skip = []
    def blk(name):
        if name not in blocks:
            blocks[name] = {'name': name, 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
            order.append(name)
        return blocks[name]
    sec = ''
    runtime = ''
    pair = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = SEC.match(l)
        if m:
            sec = m.group('s').strip().lower()
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if sec == 'device types':
            m = DT.match(l)
            if m:
                b = blk('device_types')
                b['lines'].append(i)
                b['records'].append({'Name': m.group('name'), 'Identifier': m.group('id')})
            continue
        if sec == 'runtimes':
            m = RT.match(l)
            if m:
                b = blk('runtimes')
                b['lines'].append(i)
                b['records'].append({'Name': m.group('name'), 'Version': m.group('version'), 'Build': m.group('build'), 'Identifier': m.group('id'), 'Status': m.group('status') or ''})
            continue
        if sec == 'devices':
            m = RH.match(l)
            if m:
                runtime = m.group('rt')
                b = blk('devices')
                b['lines'].append(i)
                continue
            m = DV.match(l)
            if m:
                b = blk('devices')
                b['lines'].append(i)
                b['records'].append({'Runtime': runtime, 'Name': m.group('name'), 'UDID': m.group('udid'), 'State': m.group('state'), 'Availability': m.group('avail') or ''})
            continue
        if sec == 'device pairs':
            m = PH.match(l)
            if m:
                b = blk('device_pairs')
                b['lines'].append(i)
                pair = {'Pair UUID': m.group('pair'), 'Status': m.group('status'), 'Watch': '', 'Watch UDID': '', 'Watch State': '', 'Phone': '', 'Phone UDID': '', 'Phone State': ''}
                b['records'].append(pair)
                continue
            m = PM.match(l)
            if m and pair is not None:
                r = m.group('role')
                if r in ('Watch', 'Phone'):
                    pair[r] = m.group('name')
                    pair[r + ' UDID'] = m.group('udid')
                    pair[r + ' State'] = m.group('state')
                    blk('device_pairs')['lines'].append(i)
            continue
    return {'blocks': [blocks[n] for n in order], 'skip': skip}
